device_scope: One previously paired Android test phone connected to maintenance USB, with two locally stored approved AI grant records and the existing VPN active.
actor: Maintainer fault injection and read-only Android diagnostics; no personal-AI business task in this run.
change_under_test: Service readiness judgments (isConnected and recoveryStatus) wait for the multi-AI protocol acknowledgement instead of treating an open WebSocket as ready. This does not establish that every owner-page or notification display consumes those judgments; the multi-AI owner page has its own presentation path.

upgrade.method: Maintainer performed a data-preserving USB install.
upgrade.maintainer_intervention: The maintainer opened the owner Activity before and after installation for diagnostics, then placed it in the background before the outage.
upgrade.limit: This is a maintained upgrade, not autonomous upgrade acceptance.
upgrade.credential_validation_limit: Equal local record counts do not prove that both original personal-AI credentials remain usable.

network_test.method: Disable mobile data, disable Wi-Fi, confirm the absence of a default network, then enable Wi-Fi and observe the original connection.
network_test.recovered_condition: Phone diagnostics reported a connected transport and acknowledged multi-AI protocol handshake; the local approved grant record count remained two. Each original personal-AI credential was not separately queried after recovery.
network_test.measurement_limit: One measured recovery after Wi-Fi was enabled. The delay includes network and VPN restoration plus reconnection; it is not a latency benchmark or an exclusive measurement of Airtap retry time.
network_test.performance_observation: The connection recovered, but the 44.437-second delay remains visible as a product issue; this record does not establish prompt recovery.

stability_follow_up.limit: Read-only background diagnostic samples over about one minute. This is not continuous capture, long-idle testing or proof that a personal AI can execute a task after recovery.

initial_install_precheck_failure.failure: The local installation script referenced an absent build-tools/36.0.0/apksigner executable and raised FileNotFoundError before signature verification and before invoking installation.
initial_install_precheck_failure.correction: The maintained retry used the installed build-tools/36.1.0 and completed the data-preserving install.
initial_install_precheck_failure.evidence_limit: Recorded as the maintainer account of the failed command. Its complete stderr was not saved in the retained acceptance attachments; only preflight device records were retained for that attempt.

retained_core_attempts.failure: Source-package metadata still declared the previous Android version in two manifest fields.
retained_core_attempts.correction: Update those fields to beta.20 / code50.

retained_core_attempts.failure: The approval-scheduling test harness omitted the multiHello field now read by the extracted production recoveryStatus method.
retained_core_attempts.correction: Add the missing test field; preserve all assertions and the production handshake requirement.

local_build_and_core_checks.limit: Local host and workerd checks support the implementation. They are separate from physical-device, personal-AI, production-capacity and billing acceptance.

not_verified: Post-outage status using the other original personal-AI credential.
A personal-AI phone command using its original credentials after this outage.
Two personal AIs handing off or contending for a task on this physical phone.
Cold start, reboot, unpowered idle, screen unlocking or long-idle recovery.
Stop or revocation behavior in this physical network run.
Mobile-data-only operation or operation without the existing VPN.
Migration of another phone from its existing control chain.
All later client versions or a complete product acceptance pass.
publication_boundary: Only aggregate versions, counts, timings and failure descriptions are included. No screenshots, note or post content, network addresses, phone or connection identifiers, credentials or private paths are included.

later_instinct_read_only_status.actor: Instinct using CLI.11; it reports reusing its original configuration.
later_instinct_read_only_status.original_connection_continuity: The retained sequence matched the earlier task final state; no pairing or phone operation was requested in this check.

evidence.review: Returned stdout/stderr was parsed and its attachment hash checked; unrelated private configuration was not requested.

limits: These are relay-level state queries, not a phone task, task-lease acquisition, wake or recovery acceptance.
CLI --version identifies the CLI, not the installed Android client. No ping or other phone command established the phone version.
The other original personal-AI credential was not checked in this follow-up.
The agent reports original configuration access; the correspondence between email and its prior chat execution runtime was not independently established.
